rules.name: Wild Charge
rules.description: When charging, this unit gets +1 to S

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Champion of Darkness is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, he can make a d6 test each time an enemy loses its bases in this cycle. On a score of 3 or less, the enemy must immediately take a Panic Test for as many bases as he lost in this cycle

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Choose an enemy unit within 30 cm that is not engaged in combat and make a d6 test. A score of 4 or less means the chosen unit can be moved by 10 cm in any direction, but without turning

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At any point during the cycle, Champion of Blood may take a d6 test. A score of 3 or less means that all friendly units within 20 cm of the Champion of Blood are granted +2 attacks to the pool if they do not have the Bloodshed rule. If they have it, they are granted a +1 to S bonus instead. These bonuses last until the end of the cycle.

rules.name: Priestess of Lust
rules.description: Any friendly unit within 10 cm of the Priestess of Lust may re-roll a move range, or a failed Cold Blood Test

rules.name: Born Warriors
rules.description: Vaendral army may re-roll a 1 or a 6 scored in its Activation Roll

rules.name: Curse of the Witch
rules.description: A Cold Blood Test made by an enemy unit engaged in combat with the White Witches is always considered failed

rules.name: Trample
rules.description: For each successful score in the Weapon Skill Test, roll an additional d6 for hitting. Additional successful scores do not generate the new ones

rules.name: Cult
rules.description: The enemy gains 1 Blood Point for destroying two bases instead of one in this unit

rules.name: Scare
rules.description: The enemy unit that is in base contact with this unit, must take a Panic Test at the end of the cycle for each base lost earlier in the same cycle

rules.name: Valeria
rules.description: Valeria is always accompanied by Andras and Iluar, who fight along her side in the Vaendral Army. Thanks to it, Valeria supports the unit with 8 attacks

rules.name: Chosen of the Bathed in Blood
rules.description: If the Vaendral army's General has left the battlefield, Valeria immediately takes command. The army can still use the Born Warriors special rule and use Valeria's LD 2. Valeria cannot issue orders

rules.name: Slayer's Axe
rules.description: When the unit Valeria is attached to is to make a Wound Test, you may take up to 2 dice from the pool and roll them separately. Each score od 3 or less means the enemy is dealt 3 Wounds

rules.name: Feisty Savage
rules.description: If an enemy succesfully charges the unit with an Action Die that Valeria is attached to, the unit may immediately remove the Action Die, position itself facing the enemy, and make its attacks before the enemy does

rules.name: Skull of the Priest Esn
rules.description: Valeria and her Priestesses defeated the High Priest Esn Ar Unrazr in battle. She keeps his skull, ground to powder, in a pouch on her belt. The power of the skull powder allows her to attempt to dispel an enemy spell once per battle. A score of 3 or less means a successful dispel

rules.name: The Crusher
rules.description: This mysterious artifact hammer causes Pakun to support a unit with 6 attacks plus additional attacks equal to a d6 roll. Additionally, the unit Pakun supports changes its Strength (S) to 4 if it has less

rules.name: Dark Humour
rules.description: If Pakun is attached to the Half-giants unit, the unit may add or substract 1 from its LD during any test.

rules.name: Oklar
rules.description: An enemy unit that attacks a unit that Pakun is attached to must substract 3 dice from the pool.

sharedRules.name: Light Shield Defence
sharedRules.description: For each Wound dealt to this unit, roll a d6 for the Light Shield Defence. Each score of 1 means a cancelled Wound

sharedRules.name: Bloodshed
sharedRules.description: This unit may re-roll all failed scores in the Wound Test

sharedRules.name: Fury
sharedRules.description: When charging, this unit gets +2 additional attacks to the pool for each full rank of the enemy unit or +1 additional attack for each W point of the enemy single model. The bonus from Fury can never exceed 10 attacks.
